recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. If the historical Argonaut canonical URLs must resolve, handle that in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher or fhir.org/IG web redirect infrastructure using the exact failing canonical URLs and expected rendered targets.
issue_request: FHIR-17281 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core and asked that canonical URLs for IG resources, using Argonaut examples, redirect to the current rendered pages rather than 404ing, including element-fragment canonical URLs.
initial_application: No FHIR-core git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17281 was found. Jira comments characterize the issue as old tooling and direct continuing problems to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher; source/history checks found no active core source location defining the cited Argonaut redirects.
additional_context: Argonaut is not active current core build content because source/igs.xml comments out the Argonaut IG declaration. The in-tree IG Publisher was removed in 2019 after moving to Maven. Related combined-branch audits for FHIR-12456, FHIR-12493, and FHIR-18112 already cover adjacent IG Publisher/Argonaut URL behavior. A live URL check shows the cited canonical URL still returns 404 while the rendered page returns 200.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch and made no source changes in FHIR core.

related_jiras.note: Historical Argonaut guide publication issue already audited on the combined branch; supports external IG/web publication ownership.
Old IG Publisher link behavior issue already audited on the combined branch as external-repo; supports routing continuing tooling problems to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.
Adjacent FHIR-Tools-IG canonical/value set dependency issue already audited on the combined branch and not duplicated here.
